name: Tsukumogami ni Oshiete
source:
A shota x robo-shota sci-fi digital novel.
A child genius wants to take apart a sexaroid that wanders into his workshop,
but is convinced not to with the offer of sex...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/bl/work/=/product_id/RJ267133.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
